caption: The drawing shows a single padded horse collar depicted against a plain, light beige background. The collar forms an elongated oval shape and is rendered in shades of brown, mimicking the appearance of aged and worn leather with some visible seams, dents, and rivets. There are metallic elements, including bolts, a rectangular plate at the top, and two metal rings attached opposite each other along the sides. The texture suggests weathered leather and metal, with subtle shaded details to show depth and curvature. At the upper right edge of the image, there is a small orange area that appears to be a mark or stain, not part of the collar itself. A faint handwritten signature is in the lower right-hand corner, with a date next to it.
title: Ox Collar
